questions.question: Outline the Fourth amendment in digital forensics is important? Illustrate the
questions.solution_html:
• significance.
  • The Fourth Amendment says: “The right of the people to be secure in their persons,
  • houses, papers, and effects, against unreasonable searches and seizures, shall not be
  • violated, and no Warrants shall issue, but upon probable cause, supported by Oath or
  • affirmation, and particularly describing the place to be searched, and the persons or
  • things to be seized.”
  • Any evidence deemed to be seized in violation of the Fourth Amendment is
  • inadmissible in a court of law.

questions.question: Explain Hybrid sleep. / [CO1, CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain Hybrid sleep.
  • Definition: Combines sleep and hibernation modes. RAM Storage: Saves system state in RAM
  • for quick resume. Disk Backup: Writes system state to hard disk to preserve data if power
  • fails. Power Safety: Prevents data loss during power outage unlike normal sleep. Forensic
  • Relevance: Volatile RAM data may be recovered from hibernation file (hiberfil.sys). (5 marks)
